paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
notes: This paper reports experimental bounds on ultralight dark matter (UDM) coupling to fundamental constants via an effective Lagrangian L_eff ⊃ (φ/M_Pl)[Σ_X d_m_X m_X ψ̄_X ψ_X + d_α F²/4 + d_gs β(gs)/(2gs) G²]. The couplings d_α, d_me, d_gs, d_m_hat, d_delta_m, d_m_s are scalar field couplings to fermion masses and field strength tensors, which are structurally different from the canonical AxionLimitBench coupling types (which use derivative couplings like ∂_μa and dual field tensors F∧F̃). While the paper reports novel experimental bounds in a previously unexplored frequency range (10 Hz - 100 MHz), these are not on axions or the standard scalar couplings tracked by AxionLimitBench. The paper is about general scalar UDM, not axion-like particles specifically.
